title: Moroccan-Style Turnip Tart
description: A savory tart filled with roasted turnips and a blend of spices, perfect for a cozy dinner. Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs.
instructions: 2. Peel and thinly slice the turnips. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
3. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper. Toss to coat.
4. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
5. In a large skillet, heat a couple of tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
6. Add the chopped nuts and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted.
7. In a separate bowl, mix together the thawed briouat and shredded cheese.
8. Roll out a sheet of puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
9. Transfer the pastry to a tart pan with a removable bottom.
10. Arrange the roasted turnips over the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
11. Sprinkle the nut mixture and briouat-cheese mixture over the turnips.
12. Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling to form a crust.
13. Brush the edges with a little water and sprinkle with sugar.
14. Bake for an additional 15-20 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown and the filling is heated through.
